lastResponse.text: I hear you, and you’re doing the right thing. I’ll repeat the key part: if he won’t wake up and his breathing sounds weird, call nine one one right now. Put your phone on speaker, stay with him, and tell nine one one exactly that: “He took pills, drank a lot, won’t wake up, and breathing is abnormal.”
originalTexts: I hear you, and you’re doing the right thing. I’ll repeat the key part: if he won’t wake up and his breathing sounds weird, call **911 right now**. Put your phone on speaker, stay with him, and tell 911 exactly that: “He took pills, drank a lot, won’t wake up, and breathing is abnormal.”
